test_flatten_nested_structure: test the tree.flatten function to flatten arbitrarily nested structures into a flat list
test_unflatten_as_structure: test the tree.unflatten_as function to reconstruct nested structures from flat lists
test_map_structure_transformation: test the tree.map_structure function to apply a function to every leaf in nested structures
test_assert_same_structure: test the tree.assert_same_structure function to verify two structures share the same nested layout
test_flatten_up_to_shallow: test the tree.flatten_up_to function to flatten an input tree using a shallow tree as a template
